channel.title: The Logical Indian - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: ₹85 Lakh for Momos: UP Class 7 Boy Allegedly Lured into Giving Away Family Jewellery, Probe On
item.description: A Class 7 boy in Uttar Pradesh was allegedly manipulated with free momos into handing over ₹85 lakh worth of family jewellery, triggering a police probe.

item.title: IAF Braves Extreme Snowfall to Rescue 85-Year-Old Paralysed Woman from Remote Himachal Village
item.description: Amidst heavy snow and near-zero visibility, the IAF successfully airlifts an 85-year-old paralysed woman to safety.

item.title: Meet Padma Shri Anke Gowda, the Bus Conductor Who Built India’s Largest Free Library in Karnataka
item.description: A former bus conductor, Anke Gowda, wins the Padma Shri for building a free library with twenty lakh books.

item.title: 8 Congress MPs Suspended in Lok Sabha Amid Chaos Over Naravane Memoir Cited by Rahul Gandhi
item.description: Eight Congress MPs were suspended from the Lok Sabha after repeated disruptions over Rahul Gandhi’s reference to an unpublished memoir by former Army chief MM Naravane during the Budget Session.

item.title: Bengaluru Tragedy: 15-Year-Old Dies After Alleged Fall From 7th Floor; Pub Booked For Serving Alcohol To Minor
item.description: A police probe found alleged alcohol consumption by a minor before his fatal fall, leading to action against a Bengaluru pub.

item.title: 70 Missiles, 450 Drones, Freezing Nights: Russia’s Winter Strikes Leave 1,170 Kyiv, Ukraine Buildings Without Heat
item.description: A massive Russian aerial assault on Ukraine’s energy infrastructure has plunged thousands into freezing darkness ahead of crucial peace talks.

item.title: Russia Contradicts Trump, Says India Has Not Agreed to Stop Buying Russian Oil
item.description: Moscow says it has received no communication from India about halting Russian oil imports despite Trump’s announcement of a related US–India trade deal.

item.title: One Bottle, One Bus Ticket: The Smart Idea Turning Recycling Into Sustainable Mobility
item.description: Student-led reverse vending machines are rewarding people with bus tickets for recycling plastic bottles, promoting cleaner cities and greener mobility.

item.title: Thane High-rise Fire: Two Injured, Over Seventy Residents Rescued After Early Morning Blaze
item.description: A pre-dawn electrical duct fire in a Thane residential tower injured two people and led to the safe evacuation of more than 70 residents.

item.title: Govt Notifies Baggage Rules, 2026 To Simplify Airport Procedures And Boost Transparency For Travellers
item.description: The Union Government has notified the Baggage Rules, 2026, introducing digital declarations, higher duty-free limits, and simplified customs processes to make airport travel faster, more transparent, and passenger-friendly for people travelling to and from India.
